records.public_claim_text: Expanding the use of regulatory reliance and abridged pathways WHO prequalification is now introducing a series of new regulatory pathways including new reliance pathways, through reliance on WHO Listed Authorities (as a reference) and reliance on national regulatory authorities at Maturity Level 3 and 4, i.e. considering the assessment of products approved by these regulatory authorities in certain situations.
